blocks.html: Referral Marketing is a strategy that encourages existing customers or partners to recommend a product or service to new prospects, often through incentives or structured programs.

Referral Marketing leverages word-of-mouth promotion to acquire new customers through trusted recommendations. Since people are more likely to trust suggestions from peers or colleagues, referral marketing is highly effective in generating high-quality leads and improving conversion rates. It is commonly used in both B2B and B2C industries.

items.html: Incentives such as discounts, rewards, or commissions

blocks.html: Existing customers share positive experiences with their network, driving new acquisitions.
A SaaS company offers existing users one month of free service for every successful referral who signs up for a paid subscription.
Referral Marketing is a powerful growth strategy that uses customer trust and advocacy to generate new business opportunities and drive cost-effective customer acquisition.
Turn customers into your best marketers. MarketJoy helps businesses build effective referral programs that increase leads, loyalty, and revenue growth.
